{"decision":"RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-09-17, on Alex's sentence "reflow2 does no file I/O": "should it? What would it give us if we did?"

═══ FIRST, THE SLOGAN IS NOT THE RULE — measured on the code, 2026-09-17 ═══
The server already reads and writes files: its own export, stamp, identity, sync and rendezvous sidecars (provenance.rs, identity.rs, shared.rs, discover.rs). And on 2026-09-14 Anthony ruled that reflow2 reads SOURCE TREES for analyses that report and never write (dec:reflow2-serves-source-reading-analyses-that-report-and-never-write) — so the line was crossed, on the record, three days ago. What reflow2 still does not do is touch a USER'S ARTIFACT: link_artifact, set_artifact_checksum and reconcile_artifacts take a checksum the caller computed; coverage_report takes the file list the agent observed. The rule that has actually held is dec:agent-navigates-content: the agent reads for MEANING, the graph records where it landed and never interprets. "No file I/O" was always a shorthand for "no interpretation" — and hashing a file is not interpreting it.

═══ WHAT IT WOULD GIVE US, in order of how much it changes ═══
1. A CHECKSUM BECOMES A MEASUREMENT INSTEAD OF AN ASSERTION. Requirement 2 of the 2026-09-16 set (built this same day) draws exactly this line for every number in a design: measured by a tool, or asserted by an agent. Today every checksum in reflow2's own graph is the second kind — an agent ran sha256sum and pasted the result, and the graph cannot tell a pasted hash from a made-up one. On this very increment the agent hashed 18 files by hand and one had to be re-hashed after a later edit. The qs project agent counted forty pastes and a hand-built table of 69 ids to paths (dec:idea-should-reflow2-ship-a-companion-…). A server that hashes what the graph registers turns the design's own as-built evidence from asserted to measured.
2. RECONCILE BECOMES ONE CALL WITH NO TABLE. reconcile_artifacts already refuses without `observed`; the graph is the only thing that holds the id-to-path mapping, so the table the agent builds by hand is a table reflow2 already has.
3. DRIFT IS SEEN LIVE, NOT ONLY IN CI. reflow2_check.py finds DRIFT and missing_artifact at commit time by walking the tree in Python. With the same read in the server, loop_status could say "3 registered files differ from their checksum" at every boundary, and a gate would be the second reader rather than the first.
4. THE FRONTIER GETS ITS THIRD LEG FROM THE DISK. Alex's incremental adopt (req:adopt-can-be-incremental-and-resumable-…, accepted today) needs "unmodelled neighbours adjacent to what is captured". coverage_report can only name unmodelled files the agent told it about; a root listing from the server makes the frontier a fact rather than a recollection.
5. THE SOURCE-READING ANALYSES BECOME SERVABLE IN-PROCESS. The 2026-09-14 ruling's own delivery condition is served + named + gated; tools/wall_check.py is none of those because the file read lives in Python. This is the same question from the other side.

═══ WHAT IT WOULD COST, and these are real ═══
· THE MACHINE. The graph is shared; the disk is not. A server reached over HTTP (cmp:mcp-http, the Boss+workers fleet) or a shared server on a box that does not hold the checkout would hash nothing, and a detector with nothing to run on reads exactly like one that ran clean (the standing rule). Any read must say "not on this machine" rather than report zero drift.
· GRAPH TEXT AS INSTRUCTION. An Artifact's `location` is a string somebody wrote into the graph. The moment the server dereferences it, graph text has become a directive to the server — the one thing AGENTS.md's standing rule forbids. A registered location of ../../etc/passwd would be read. So: root-bounded (never outside the directory the graph lives under), no symlink following, registered-or-listed only, and NEVER RETURNS CONTENT — a hash, a size, a mtime, an existence. Bytes in, a number out.
· THE DOCTRINE, kept: dec:three-party-checks — the LLM speaks, the graph remembers and COUNTS, the human decides. Hashing is counting. Parsing, extracting, navigating a thousand pages is speaking, and stays the agent's (dec:agent-navigates-content stands untouched).
· THE WRENCH. Every item above is reflow2 work for reflow2's users. What makes it admissible is that two users asked (qs, 2026-09-04; Alex, 2026-09-17) and the standing rule says to wait for exactly that.

═══ THE OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
A. KEEP THE SLOGAN, SHIP THE COMPANION: a CLI verb beside the server hashes the registered set and calls reconcile (the open idea of 2026-09-04, option ②). Cheapest; keeps the MCP surface pure. ⚠️ The companion needs the graph AND the disk in one process anyway, so "pure" is a matter of which binary.
B. ⭐ RESTATE THE RULE AS "reflow2 MEASURES files and never reads them for meaning", and let the server do the measuring under the conditions above: link_artifact and set_artifact_checksum compute the hash when the caller omits it and record `basis: measured` (asserted when pasted — the provenance vocabulary of requirement 2, applied to the design's own evidence); reconcile_artifacts takes `observed` OR walks the registered set; coverage_report can list the root; loop_status reports live drift; every read refuses, by name, on a machine that does not hold the tree. ⚠️ Cost: the boundary that granularity and consumption state in their module docs moves, and moves for all of them at once.
C. GO ALL THE WAY: the source analyses read content in-process, as the 2026-09-14 ruling already permits. ⚠️ Counter: that ruling has its own order (the wall check first) and its own three conditions; folding it in here decides it twice.
D. NOTHING: the rule is deliberate, the workaround is a shell script. ⚠️ Counter, in the users' words: "the most repetitive work of the day", forty times, and the graph's own checksums remain the one number in the design that says how it was obtained by saying nothing.

═══ THE HONEST LIMIT ═══
A server-side hash proves the file on disk is the file the design describes. It says nothing about whether the file is right — that stays with the check the design names for it (requirement 3, closure), and with the partner tool that can open the format (requirement 1, the domain standard).
